findings.statement: Answer-Engine Optimisation (AEO) is becoming as important as traditional SEO, with AI-powered search expected to overtake conventional search by 2028.
evidence: “Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is now just as important as SEO” and Gartner forecasts that “by 2028 AI-powered search will displace conventional web search as the primary discovery channel for consumers”

findings.statement: LLM reputation management is emerging as a distinct discipline because journalists and influencers already rely on tools like ChatGPT, meaning brand perception is shaped inside AI outputs.
evidence: “Journalists and influencers are increasingly using LLMs as research aids… LLM reputation management is emerging as a new discipline”

findings.statement: Building resilience to mis- and dis-information is now considered as fundamental for organisations as cybersecurity or data privacy, due to the speed and impact of false narratives.
evidence: “Brands that can spot and neutralize false narratives quickly will avoid costly clean-ups… In 2026, building misinformation resilience is as fundamental as cybersecurity or data privacy”

findings.statement: Social customer care has become critical for brand reputation because over 70 % of internet users use social platforms to research brands, and slow responses erode trust.
evidence: “More than 70 percent of worldwide internet users aged 16 and up use social platforms to find information about brands… Social customer care is critical for brand reputation”

findings.statement: Advances in AI now make psychographic segmentation and personalisation at scale practical, delivering measurable sales lifts for brands that adopt it.
evidence: “Advances in AI now make that kind of psychographic segmentation and micro-targeting feasible at scale… brands can see a two percent lift in incremental sales”
